items.title: Diagnose and fix the cli-json-stdout-contract-smoke hang (killed at the 300s ceiling)
items.context: packages/main/src/tasks/cli-json-stdout-contract-smoke.ts hangs and is re-run in every npm test / lattice validate pass (~5min each). Find WHY it never exits (subprocess/stdin wait) and fix the hang or make it fail-fast. DO NOT just raise/skip the timeout — that would mask a real CLI json-stdout contract hang (the CLI not terminating is itself a product bug). Side-effect of muting: hides a real non-termination defect.

items.title: Fix field-regression-cli-smoke stale background-section headers
items.context: packages/main/src/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.ts (~line 1636) builds a story_create background with '## Key Insight' / '## Trade-offs' / '## Conversation Texture', which the current background-validator rejects (needs '## Key Insights' / '## Solution Tradeoffs' / '## Conversational Texture'), so story_create exits 1 → fails on main. Update ONLY the 3 section headers; keep the hotfix-priority-elevation assertion intact (deleting the test loses that coverage).

items.title: Surface missing binding fields at autopilot_review_submit time (no silent ignore)
items.context: autopilot_review_submit accepts a verdict (decision:pass) but if it omits promptDigest/validationDigest the verdict is silently moved to review_escalation_status.degradedFallback.ignoredVerdicts (reason: 'missing binding field(s)') → 0/3 valid rounds with no error at submit. Add a loud submit-time warning + explicit missing-field list (or a --strict error / extend quorum_submit to emit a valid degraded 3x1 single-host round). Side-effect: a hard reject could break automation submitting partial verdicts — prefer warning/opt-in strict.
items.userSees: User sees missing binding warning output and non-silent handling of incomplete verdicts

happy.desc: Submit local pass verdict via autopilot_review_submit with all required bindings and observe explicit warning on missing fields

edge.desc: Submit verdict with one missing binding and verify warning still records in note without fail-closed behavior

adversarial.desc: Submit repeated degraded evidence and confirm it is visible in review-escalation/degraded fallback rows

items.title: Triage the other pre-existing main smoke failures
items.context: On main (independent of any story): english-open-source-surface and prompt-token-cost exit 1; global-agents-init is a flake (passes on retry and on direct invocation). Determine if each is a real regression or a stale fixture; fix or document. Low risk; investigation item.

items.title: Fix doneClosure not honoring the degraded-3x1 review-assurance-floor that review_escalation_status accepts
items.context: Repro on B-fbca (2026-06-24): after recording review_escalation_fallback_set (single-host-environment) + submitting 3 valid degraded single-host verdicts (autopilot_review_submit with all 4 binding fields materialDigest+storyFilesHash+validationDigest+promptDigest, bound to the current materialHash), `review_escalation_status` reports ok=true / degradedFallback: pass (N/3 rounds x 1 host). But `done_prepare` doneClosure reports the SAME floor as `review-assurance-floor: missing; local rounds 0/3` on the SAME materialHash (4829785e), with main quiescent (0 new commits, no concurrent drift). The two floor-check code paths disagree: review_escalation_status honors the degraded 3x1 fallback; doneClosure appears to count only full 2-host local rounds and does NOT honor the degraded fallback, so DONE is blocked even though the assurance floor is satisfied. Fix: make doneClosure honor the same degraded-fallback-satisfied state review_escalation_status accepts (or share the floor-evaluation fn). Side-effect of a naive fix: if doneClosure is INTENTIONALLY stricter (requires full 3x2 for DONE even when review_escalation_status accepts degraded), then the bug is the inconsistent messaging — review_escalation_status should NOT report ok=true; align them either way.
